correctness.rationale: Definitions and normalization were checked: C_n^3 connects residues of cyclic distance <=3; the ordinary three-cut facets are complements of disconnected induced 3-sets, not of independent sets alone. Every facet has n-3 vertices. The exact 169 masks at n=13 and 238 masks at n=14 in shellings.json were independently recomputed by graph-traversal connectivity and matched uniquely as the complete facet sets. For every facet after the first, independently computed its prior ridges and verified nonempty intersection and for every earlier facet a containing earlier ridge; zero failed checks. The complete down-closures had 7904 and 16067 nonempty faces. Exactly 1 and 8 facets have full restriction sets, proving respectively S^9 and wedge_8 S^10 via pure shellability. The cited Chauhan–Shukla Theorem 1.4 actually covers n>=6p-3, so p=3 covers n>=15. Combining the exact finite proofs with that published theorem yields shellability for every n>=13 and sphere multiplicity (n^2-13n+2)/2. No inference from finite enumeration to n>=15 is made.
residual_risks: For n>=15 the theorem explicitly depends on the published general result; no result is asserted for 9<=n<=12 or p>=4.
